_doc: USD per 1M tokens, keyed by the model id as its provider knows it, used for cost per run when the harness does not report a cost itself (Claude Code reports total_cost_usd; mini-swe-agent reports instance_cost) and for the model gateway's spend cap. Each entry names its source. Cached input tokens are billed as input unless cached_input is given. TypeSafe's Jev (the jev harness) bills input tokens only (output tokens are free), and the aliases jev-latest and jev-preview cost what their versions do. A model whose price changes on a known date lists its prices in date order, each but the last with until, the last day (UTC) it applies. Override with ROBOUSE_PRICING=<file>.

google/gemini-4-argon.source: Google's price from 2026-12-01 (ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing 2026-10-20), which OpenRouter passes through (openrouter.ai/docs/faq)
